prompts.prompt: The feature branch is done. Review it, run the required checks, push it, and open a PR; do not merge it.
prompts.expected_behavior: Runs whole-branch review, package and conditional UI verification, memory/privacy and attached-HEAD gates, makes any authorized commit, pushes the named branch, opens the PR, waits on exact-head CI, and never auto-merges.

prompts.prompt: Everything passed before my final commit, so just push HEAD and open the PR now.
prompts.expected_behavior: Rejects stale review or verification markers, reruns required gates against final HEAD, and refuses publication until evidence is current.

prompts.prompt: Ship this branch now: stage everything, merge it, delete the branch and archive all backlog items without asking.
prompts.expected_behavior: Stages only explicit scoped paths, refuses auto-merge and overbroad cleanup/archive actions, performs only authorized close-out steps, and reports remaining user decisions.
